title: 🔥 Is Pete Hegseth About to Get FIRED? | Chris Cillizza
description:
🚨 Is Pete Hegseth about to be fired?

The pressure is building on Trump’s Secretary of Defense as prominent Republicans criticize the chaos and turnover at the Pentagon. With the Iran war increasingly unpopular, Trump may soon need a high-profile scapegoat — and Hegseth could be at the top of the list. 👀

In this video, I break down:• Why GOP criticism of Hegseth is growing 🪖• The Pentagon leadership shake-up• How the Iran war could put Hegseth in political danger 📉• Why Trump may not love Hegseth’s 2028 ambitions• What betting markets suggest about his future 🔥
